title: Kernel-Type Fractional Extensions of Reverse Callebaut, Rogers Hölder and Cauchy Schwarz Inequalities on Time Scales
summary: In this paper, we establish kernel-type fractional extensions of reverse Callebaut, Rogers--Hölder and Cauchy--Schwarz inequalities on time scales. The proposed results are formulated by means of a nonnegative kernel operator associated with the diamond-$α$ integral, which enables the inclusion of memory effects within the framework of dynamic inequalities. By choosing particular kernels and time scales, the obtained inequalities reduce to their continuous, discrete and quantum counterparts.
